card.name: The word on after ECG findings
card.fires_on: The small word "on" right after an ECG finding such as QT prolongation or T-wave changes, just before "ECG" or "the electrocardiogram". It also fires on nearby linking words in similar spots.

modes.label: on after ECG finding
modes.description: The word "on" links an ECG abnormality to the electrocardiogram.

modes.label: other linking words
modes.description: A linking word like "and", "or" or "by" in a clause about a test or procedure.
modes.example: LVH and LVD can be diagnosed utilizing echocardiography<< or>> another suitable cardiac imaging modality.
